hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND" | grep -q 'git push'; then echo "[safety] about to push to remote — ensure PR description is ready"; fi

if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND" | grep -q 'git commit'; then if git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -qE '^\.env$|settings\.local\.json'; then echo "[BLOCKED] Refusing to commit .env or settings.local.json — these files contain secrets and are gitignored"; exit 1; fi; fi

FILE="$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_FILE_PATH"; if echo "$FILE" | grep -q 'artifacts/'; then echo "[pipeline] artifact written: $FILE"; if echo "$FILE" | grep -q 'requirements.md'; then echo "  => Stage 1 done. Next: @architecture-agent"; elif echo "$FILE" | grep -q 'architecture.md'; then echo "  => Stage 2 done. Next: @design-review-agent"; elif echo "$FILE" | grep -q 'design-review.md'; then echo "  => Stage 3 done. Next: @implementation-planning-agent"; elif echo "$FILE" | grep -q 'impl-plan.md'; then echo "  => Stage 4 done. Next: @implementation-agent"; elif echo "$FILE" | grep -q 'code-review.md'; then echo "  => Stage 6 done. Next: @verify-agent"; elif echo "$FILE" | grep -q 'verification-report.md'; then echo "  => Stage 7 done. Next: @create-pr-agent"; fi; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND" | grep -q 'pytest'; then echo "[pipeline] test run complete — check output above for failures"; fi
